explication: MCP Filesystem Server exposes local-file operations and file resources over MCP. The main workflow is an MCP client request routed by the server to filesystem handlers, which validate paths against configured allowed directories before accessing the local filesystem and returning content or results. The README documents the broader operation set; sampled source confirms server registration, CLI startup, path checks, and representative read/search behavior. Some handler-to-helper details are not shown for every operation, so the graph groups the handler suite rather than asserting unobserved call paths.
